Built for Everyday Riding

Coming Soon
The Corsa Cross200 marks the beginning of the Corsa hybrid bicycle lineup.
Designed around the idea that a dependable hybrid bike should be comfortable, practical, and easy to ride every day, the Cross200 is built for commuting, neighborhood rides, weekend fitness, and everyday transportation.
Rather than chasing short-term trends, the Corsa philosophy focuses on proven components, balanced geometry, and long-term reliability—qualities that riders continue to appreciate year after year.
Product images and specifications shown on this page represent the planned production model and may be updated before the official release.

Designed for Everyday Use
The Cross200 is intended for riders who want one bicycle capable of handling a variety of everyday situations.
Whether commuting to work, riding local bike paths, visiting neighborhood cafés, or enjoying weekend rides with family and friends, the Cross200 is designed to provide a comfortable, predictable riding experience.

Built on Proven Components
The planned production model features a lightweight aluminum frame, Shimano drivetrain, suspension fork, Tektro brakes, and 700C wheels—components selected for their reliability, ease of maintenance, and everyday performance.

Our Approach
At Corsa, we believe a good bicycle should remain enjoyable to ride for years—not just during the first few rides.
That philosophy guides every decision behind the Cross200, from its riding position to its component selection.

Coming Soon
The Corsa Cross200 is currently being prepared for release.
Additional product information, availability, and final specifications will be announced closer to launch.
